why: `Gizmo()` in `use.m` calls the file's local function `Gizmo`, which comes before the classdef `Gizmo.m` (MATLAB doc 'Function Precedence Order': local functions first), so `g` is a struct and `tidy(g)` calls `tidy.m`, not `Gizmo`'s method (the step 15 review's probe; wrong before step 15 too). In `recv.m` the same holds for a member call: `g.tidy()` reads a field of the struct, no method of `Gizmo` (two classes define `tidy`, so nothing names one).
